text:
MSMEs make 48.58% of India's exports.

That is nearly half of everything India sells abroad, according to a PIB document published in June 2026 (January 2026 data). The same document says registrations on the Udyam portal and Udyam Assist platform have crossed 8.7 crore.

Why it matters for an owner:
• Export buyers expect clean GST invoices and on time delivery.
• Stock numbers have to match what is really on the shelf.
• Dues have to be followed up before they hurt cash flow.

What to do: pick one weekly check. Pending invoices, stock below reorder level, and who owes you money. If it takes more than a few minutes, the records are too spread out.

You can see how this looks on one screen in our live demos with sample data, no sign-up:
https://www.resolveai.cc

Does your business export, or supply someone who does?

Source: PIB, "From Enterprise to Empowerment: The MSME Story" (June 2026).
